title: Extension clause from structural coherent homomorphism data
statement: Given the structural data of Lemma 01YB, every morphism on the open complement extends from some ideal power times G.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 01YB (label lemma-homs-over-open); its proof uses Properties lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open, lemma-quasi-coherent-colimit-finite-type, Lemmas 01Y8 (lemma-acc-coherent), Artin-Rees (lemma-Artin-Rees) and the quasi-coherence of the sheaf Hom from a finitely presented module

proof.text: Extract D, e, c and the compatibility and bijectivity clauses from d.hcolim. For a given ψ choose its preimage z under colimit.desc using the surjectivity clause. Mathlib Concrete.colimit_exists_rep gives n and an element of D.obj n representing z; the forgetful functor preserves this filtered colimit by Mathlib.Algebra.Category.Grp.FilteredColimits and preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_shrink. Transport that element through (e n).hom. The inverse-isomorphism identity and colimit.ι_desc show that c.app n sends its inverse representative to ψ. Apply the cocone compatibility clause to obtain the desired equality. No geometric theorem or structural-data existence theorem is used.

proof_origin.reason: Direct Mathlib finite-stage representative argument from the supplied structural data; Stacks Project Lemma 01YB final in-particular clause.

theorem coherent_homs_over_open_extension {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    [CompactSpace X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F G : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (d : CoherentHomsOverOpenData I F G) :
    ∀ ψ : (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf d.U).obj G ⟶
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf d.U).obj F,
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (χ : idealModuleProduct (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G ⟶ F),
        (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf d.U).map
            (idealModuleProductι (idealSheafPower I.toModulesι n).2 G) ≫ ψ =
          (SheafOfModules.overFunctor X.ringCatSheaf d.U).map χ
